task.summary: Default task
Due to a problem with VST2 instrument crashing the DAW, backed off the frequency of calling VST2 editor idle and made sure to only call VST2 editor idle once the editor has been opened.

Reduced latency when playing a note from an external midi keyboard by reducing the nuber of blocks in the instrument track background processor from 20 to 2. When recording events into a riff set riff, adjusted the note position by getting the modulus using the riff length - further work is needed to overwrite overlapping notes or introduce takes (for the distant future). Separated time critical jack event handling out from normal jack event handling. Moved scanning for audio plugins and starting the autosave thread from the main function to separate functions called by main.

Tidied up closing the application, making sure to shut down all tracks and their plugins. When creating a new file or opening a file, making sure to shut down all tracks and their plugins for the project being replaced.
Removed unused dependencies.
Fixed a number of bugs relating the playing and recording of audio plugin parameters.
Changed the beat grid automation custom painter to only draw the riff refs when in CurrentView::Track.
Fixed a pointer issue.
Added vst3_checker to parent Cargo.toml.
Added VST3 plugin usage.
Updated submodule version.

Fixed scanned instrument and effect plugin data read from configuration being emptied when resetting state. Fixed missing vst3 logic when setting the selected instrument plugin in the track details dialogue. Fixed failing to set the newly created riff as the selected riff in the track details dialogue.
Added pitch bend editing. Added Vst3 pitch bend and controller handling.

Completed second pass MPE implementation. Add use of a thread pool. Added delete vst3 plugin functionality with workarounds for crashes when removing the plugin from the thread local map (destructors probably not cleaning things up properly - have omitted plugin deletion from the map in the meantime).
Fixed an issue where note velocities could not be selected for editing.

Set up a midi file import dialogue instance for the life of the application with new directories added as shortcuts - allows easy navigation back to the same folder - gtk3 resets the directory on hide.
Fixed piano roll unable to empty selection by dragging a select rectangle with no notes in it.
Fixed deleting a track causes no audio - had not removed the audio consumer from the audio layer.

Added automatic naming of riff sets based on the active riff references - first cut, manual naming still available but overwritten when incrementing through track riffs in a riff set. Fixed an issue with all the riff sets in the riff arrangement UI view having the very first riff set's name.
Added riff grid implementation - not complete. Refactored where appropriate to fit in with riff grid addition.
Fixed a bug in the EditItemHandler when dealing with RiffReferences where it was not distinguishing between any riff reference that pointed to the same riff on a given track.

Added the Steinberg vst3sdk github repo as a submodule and adjusted the C++ build to suit. Added build-essential debian package dependency to the github build. Added riff grid riff reference change action implementations. Started adjusting riff arrangement view play cursor update code - needs more work, probably broken in a couple of places.
Added vst3sdk submodule directory.
Fixed a broken unit test - from Midi MPE changes.
Added vst3_checker build artifact upload.
Fixed some automation editing. Implemented more automation editing. Added riff start note functionality and riff reference play mode functionality.

Added use of selected items to EditItemHandler when the edited item is one of selected items - the move, charge start and change end operation is performed on all the selected items in the current view (context). Added copying of selected items when the control key is pressed to EditItemHandler.

Refactored editing - moved old selection code to store the uuids of the selected and moved old editing code to use the selected uuids. Fixed bugs in the EditItemHandler. Added a drag copy mode. Made the riff grid drawing area focusable to allow key events to set the edit mode. Added a loop mode keyboard shortcut to the track grid and the riff grid. Added a riff grid riff reference mode keyboard shortcut to the riff grid.
Added multi-track editing.
Added more selection/deselection editing functionality.

Added rough cut windowed zoom. Added automation envelopes. Added select and unselect all. Added automation change editing. Upgraded the quantise functionality. Added triplet functionality. Changed to separate selection state and copy buffers for the track and the riff grids. Added song time display. Removed the timeouts when requesting preset data.
Fixed some code quality issues. Added drawing of riff sequence and riff grid riff references to the riff arrangement automation view.

Fixed automation change editing to set a minimum value of 0.0. Added automation value label. Made export as wave file context sensitive - when viewing the track grid export the track grid sequence audio and when viewing a riff arrangement export it as audio.
Fixed updating of available items in blades that have combo-boxes. Made combobox element names consistent.
Added proper handling of tempo, sample rate, block size changes and time signature. Added a time signature numerator and denominator spinners to the UI.
Added use of time signature numerator to change grid horizontal rendering. Added editing of riff length via a riff reference in the track grid view.
Added cycling through the linked to riffs for a riff reference.
Fixed a unit test.

Made sure that everything is using the block size and sample rate from configuration. Set the buffer sizes to the maximum buffer size of 2048 (4096 causes a crash due to memory issues). Caught some more tempo value issues. Added use of time signature values instead of hard coded values.

Updated the vst-rs git submodule to the latest version (use of custom number of samples to process from the buffer - buffer size is set to the max buffer value of 2048 frames and only block size frames need to be processed).
Updated the vst-rs git submodule to the latest version (fixed a bug with a plugin not returning any preset data - caused a crash). Fixed the track event sorting algorithm.

Add plugin path configuration to the configuration dialogue. Added a scan for plugins menu item under a new 'Utils' menu. Added UI feedback whilst plugins are being scanned. Added changing of selected notes MPE note id when changing the selected MPE note id to be used.

Add plugin path configuration to the configuration dialogue. Added a scan for plugins menu item under a new 'Utils' menu. Added UI feedback whilst plugins are being scanned. Added changing of selected notes MPE note id when changing the selected MPE note id to be used.
Fixed unit tests in riff-daw and vst-rs.
Changed th release build optimisation level to 2 from 3 - seems to give better performance.

Added a riff arrangement overview. Modified riff set combo boxes to have a completion entry - seems to fix the issue of oversized combo box when setting a max length on the completion. Changed the open file code to give more updates to the progress dialogue and to get a lock on the state multiple time rather that in one large block. Fixed some if statement duplicated conditions. Fixed export to wave file incorrectly set block size (was set to the sample rate).
Added updating of the playing riff set.
Experimental play with Xilem GUI library.
Changed to 2024 edition. Fixed lockup when closing the main window. Fixed application panic when clicking any track panel button.
Added updating of the configuration bookmarks from the file_dialog bookmarks. Added saving of the configuration when the application closes.
